title: 第7章 她说，她找到了亡母旧人
lines: 相府的夜，越来越像一张网。
每一个脚步声，都像试探。
但没人知道，她已经不再“被困”。
风从破窗灌进来，带着寒意。
每一个名字后面，都标着两个字——
content_zh:
相府的风，越来越紧。

    紧到连下人走路都开始低头，不敢多说一句话。

    因为所有人都知道——

    那个被打了一巴掌还敢还手的嫡女苏晚，已经不再是“能欺负的人”。

    但苏柔不信。

    她不可能信。

    午后，西偏院外。

    苏柔站在门口。

    身后跟着两名贴身丫鬟，还有一名医女。

    她今日穿得格外素净，连发饰都少了几分华丽。

    看起来像是“来赔罪”的。

    但她的眼神，不是。

    那是一种压着刀的平静。

    她抬手，轻轻敲门。

    “姐姐。”

    声音柔得几乎发软。

    “我来看看你。”

    门开了。

    苏晚站在里面。

    一身素衣，神色平静。

    像什么都没发生过。

    苏柔一瞬间有点不舒服。

    这种人，不哭，不怒，不恨。

    太干净了。

    干净得像根本不属于相府。

    苏柔微微一笑。

    “姐姐，昨日之事，是嬷嬷鲁莽了。”

    “她已经受罚。”

    她说得很轻。

    仿佛那一巴掌，从来没有发生过。

    苏晚看着她。

    没有回应。

    苏柔继续。

    “毕竟我们都是一家人。”

    “一家人之间，哪有隔夜仇？”

    她说到这里，往前一步。

    “我特意带了医女来。”

    “给姐姐看看脸上的伤。”

    话说得温柔。

    却一步一步，把“关心”变成“施舍”。

    周围丫鬟低头不语。

    谁都知道。

    这是来“收场”的。

    把昨天那一巴掌，变成“误会”。

    把苏晚，再按回“被原谅”的位置。

    苏晚忽然笑了一下。

    很轻。

    但很冷。

    “你来，是为了道歉？”

    苏柔立刻点头。

    “当然。”

    苏晚点头。

    “那很好。”

    她转身，让开一步。

    “进来。”

    苏柔心中一松。

    成了。

    她就知道。

    苏晚这种人，昨天不过是“逞强”。

    今天，只要给她一点台阶，她就会下。

    她带着人走进西偏院。

    院子破旧。

    但很干净。

    干净得不像一个“废院”。

    苏柔扫了一眼。

    心里更不舒服了。

    她本该住在这里腐烂的。

    怎么还能这么干净？

    屋内。

    苏晚坐下。

    苏柔坐在对面。

    气氛“温和”。

    苏柔柔声道：

    “姐姐，昨日嬷嬷冲动，是我管教不严。”

    “我替她向你赔罪。”
content_en:
The morning air in the Prime Minister's Mansion should have been quiet.

    But today is different.

    A circle of people had gathered early at the entrance of the west courtyard.

    The maids, the nuns, the nursing staff, and even the stewards all came.

    Everyone is waiting for a "result".

    Waiting for Su Wan who saved the old lady overnight——

    Can we continue to be "arrogant"?

    Su Wan just opened the door.

    There was a gust of cold wind in front of me.

    The next second.

    "Crack!"

    A slap fell without warning.

    The force is very heavy.

    The air became silent for a moment.

    Su Wan's face was hit to the side.

    The people around him took a breath.

    The person who took action was the stepmother’s personal nun.

    She retracted her hand with a cold face.

    "Presumptuous."

    "The Prime Minister's Mansion is a place where you can give acupuncture to save people at will?"

    "The old lady has just woken up, and you dare to act like a ghost in the house?"

    Her voice was shrill.

    Every word carries "rules".

    It's like cleaning up the dirt in the prime minister's house.

    People around him immediately agreed.

    "That's right!"

    "A man who came out of an abandoned hospital actually dared to use needles in the old lady's room!"

    "If something happens, who will be responsible?"

    Su Rou stood behind the crowd, the corners of her lips raised slightly.

    She had been waiting for this slap for a long time.

    Not a slap in the face.

    It's "qualitative".

    ——Su Wan is an unruly lunatic.

    Su Wan said nothing.

    She just slowly raised her hand.

    He touched his face lightly.

    Hot.

    reality.

    She raised her eyes.

    Look at grandma.

    At that glance, it was very quiet.

    It was uncomfortably quiet.

    Grandma frowned:

    "What are you looking at? Why don't you kneel down and admit your mistake?"

    Su Wan suddenly smiled.

    Very light.

    So soft that there is almost no sound.

    "You hit me."

    she said.

    Grandma snorted coldly:

    "The one I hit is you!"

    "The rules of the prime minister's office don't allow you to be arrogant!"

    Su Wan nodded.

    "Okay."

    She said only one word.

    Then——

    Take a step forward.

    No one could see when she moved.

    Only a muffled sound was heard.

    "Crack!!!"

    Heavier than before.

    More simply.

    Grandma was slapped so hard that she staggered back and hit the doorpost.

    His face instantly swelled.

    The whole place was dead silent.

    Some people didn't even realize what was happening.

    "You...you dare to fight back?!"
title_en: Chapter 6 The murderous intention at the dinner table in the Hou Mansion
